Questions No. 18 and 19 are Long Answer Type questions. Answer any one of the following. (5x1=5)

(i) Methane    (ii) Ethane
(iii) Propane  (iv) Butane
(v) Pentane                                                                  (5)
19. Define the following terms:

(iii) Gangue   (iv) Calcination
